- Validates/normalizes `at` via `ensure_utc`.
- Sets the invoice status to `"void"`.
- Records an audit event.
- Returns `{"invoice_id", "amount", "reason"}` with the invoice total.

All 10 tests pass, and edge cases (draft/paid/void invoices) were verified.
